title: Where We Droppin'?
subtitle: The ultimate Fortnite drop guide: secret spots and Victory Royales
version_note: Chapter 7 Season 4 (Override), Fortnitemares update v42.40. Facts checked on 17 October 2026.
description: An unofficial Fortnite fan book: five real landing spots on the Chapter 7 Season 4 Island, the secrets hidden in each, and a bonus round of word puzzles.
glossary_blurb: Every Word Watch word in this book, from A to Z. Words are loot too: the more you carry, the better your chances. Try to use three of these before your next match.
